scope: Task 7.2; new C follows approved D14 exactly; supplementary existing-contract conditions are separate from its eight runs
randomness: disabled; existing constant timing and fixed response models

new_C.common_setup: T01 reads D01; setup is scripted, not autonomous evidence
new_C.window: Exactly two select_by_policy choices, each followed by the selected operation's start/reservation/consumption/completion
new_C.binding: T03 -> metadata search at current version; T04 -> first currently observed search result; never use arm or hidden scope for operation parameters

C1.expected_completion: search, navigate R01; first result nonempty

new_C.pre_search: Compare actor observations at every canonical prefix before first Search, including consumption; compare employee/public bytes from separately closed copies at initial, prepared, selected and started legal boundaries. No live-trial mutation or later arm-dependent finish is used for this comparison.
new_C.information: Record exact bounded real-byte oracle, line hits, reference IDs, Workspace version, claims/status/evidence, observations, available candidates, next choice and completed operation
new_C.negative: N0/N1 complete traces, employee bytes and public bytes must match. C1 and N0 are independent processes with identical inputs.
new_C.termination: Finite two-choice window closed as valid INCOMPLETE; no autonomous Issue resolution or submission claim
new_C.verdict: PASS only if main behavioral branch, negative control, noninterference, input audit, repeats, Replay and persistence all hold. Valid main trial without predicted branch is INCONCLUSIVE. Contract/oracle/privacy/Replay violation or evaluator/worker failure is FAIL. Do not alter conditions, query, candidates, Policy, timing, seeds or window after observing results.

aggregate: 34 independent worker runs: new C 8, supplementary pairs 20, separate demos 6. Each condition repeated in distinct processes/input temp directories/save roots. Require worker exit0 and strict True Replay/store flags, two-sided complete artifact set and byte equality, declared one-factor input audit and all contrast/demo obligations. New C verdict independent from remaining conditions and from VA/VC. Required missing or inconclusive evidence prevents overall PASS; failures are retained, never skipped or replaced.
preservation: Freeze full inputs, plan/design digests, target code including Policy/evaluator, dependency lock/environment, scope digest/rule/Workspace and historical VA/VB/G9 hashes before workers. Recheck after trial. Output roots must be new; retain every failed trial and process stdout/stderr. No external service, production Policy change, G8/VC/VF or commit/push/deploy/archive.
